name: Muscogee County, GA
findings: Muscogee County has 616 nonprofit organizations. 230 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 176 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Muscogee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 74 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 74 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.text: 2 economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.
